packageRules.description: Group all patch updates into a single PR. Auto-merge is safe at the patch level — semver promises no API surface change.
Minor updates get a single grouped PR per week; founder reviews before merge. Never auto-merged — minors sometimes ship behavior changes despite semver guarantees.
Major updates land as separate PRs so breaking changes are reviewed one-by-one. Auto-merge is explicitly disabled (hostile audit b: no major auto-merge).
The @settlegrid/mcp SDK is our own package — treat minor and major bumps as breaking-change candidates and route through the codemod framework rather than Renovate direct.
packageRules.prBodyTemplate:
Renovate detected a minor or major bump of `@settlegrid/mcp`. Before merging, run the codemod suite to migrate any breaking-change usage in the templates:

```
node scripts/codemods/run-all.mjs --apply --smoke-test 10
```

If the codemod suite reports no changes, the bump is safe to merge. If it modifies files, open a follow-up PR with the codemod changes first and merge this PR after.
